test_title: PYST 43: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 5 6 6 4 1 8 4 9 6 4 9 7 2 2 7 1 4 1 8 7 3 (Right)

How many such odd digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 5 6 6 4 1 8 4 9 6 4 9 7 2 2 7 1 4 1 8 7 3 (Right)

Now,

Odd digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Even — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd6e3ab7f7e463bf23b9110fea65737dbc5d5de67e67d932cc1afd1755125ffb.png] Thus, there are 3 odd digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an even digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
